WITH station_stats AS (
  SELECT
    observstation,
    AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct,
    COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
station_ratios AS (
  SELECT
    observstation,
    avg_bandusagepct,
    telescope_count,
    telescope_count * 1.0 / AVG(telescope_count) OVER () AS count_ratio
  FROM station_stats
)
SELECT observstation, avg_bandusagepct, telescope_count, count_ratio
FROM station_ratios
ORDER BY count_ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
